problems.prompt: A thermal neutron on ²³⁵U can induce:
choices: Only β⁺ decay of the neutron
problems.explain: ²³⁵U is fissile — thermal n capture can lead to fission with ~200 MeV released.

problems.prompt: The Q-value is the energy from the ____ defect (converted with ≈931.5 MeV/u).
If Q = −1.88 MeV for ⁷Li(p,n)⁷Be, is E_lab = 1.0 MeV above threshold? Enter 0 for no, 1 for yes.
problems.explain: Need E ≳ threshold (~1.88 MeV); 1.0 MeV is below — channel closed.
